title: The Last Vector Again
author: Jude Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Hartwell, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
